Zoe: Heads-up — Northfield Analytics spun up two new teams (recommendations + alerts) and their ingestion jumped ~3x overnight. Looks like product launch prep. @Malik can you eyeball capacity? :eyes:
Malik: On it. Which project tags?
Zoe: org:northfield, projects: nf-recs, nf-alerts. They said alerts need near-RT updates, recs can be hourly.
Priya: PM note: "Piloting cross-user recs v1. Targeting 40k embeddings/day, peak batch bursts ~6k/hr. Want <300ms p95 for alerts."
Owen: 40k/day steady should be okay, but combined gen + embeds could push tails. Renewal in ~4 months; they tied pilot success to renewal upsell.
capacity-bot: auto-allocated +2 concurrent workers to hosted-pool-4 for org:northfield (policy: short-burst).
Malik: Quick probe: alerts p50 ~85ms p95 ~360ms; recs embed p95 ~410ms. With +2 workers alerts p95 -> ~170ms.
AE-Lina: This reads like an expansion trigger. Recommend a 10-day reserved pod as stopgap and a Dedicated pilot for multi-team scale. I'll loop the AE.
Priya: Also capturing feedback: their docs ingestion shows many trimmed HTML snippets causing tokenization spikes. Need tokenization sniff and content prefilter suggestions.
Zoe: Action items — @Malik run a 3hr sustained perf test and attach traces; @Priya create onboarding checklist and tokenization sniff script; @AE-Lina prepare pilot quote + renewal play; schedule 30m enablement for their infra team.
Owen: I'll add a small eval set to guard quality when we tune batching/quantization.
AE-Lina: Booking enablement tomorrow 11am PT. Sending pilot quote EOD.
Zoe: Flagging as expansion-opportunity and adding to CS leadership lane. Follow-up in Monday sync. :calendar:
